original_test_intent: Read and byte-accurately validate the SMBIOS Type 25 System Power Controls schedule fields.

original_procedure_criteria.procedure: Collect the one applicable 09h structure and decode five BCD schedule fields including invalid values.

historical_reviews.v3: IMPROVED; REQUIRES and excludes power actuation/reboot persistence.

v3_1_conclusion.manual_test_activity: Engineer supplies expected schedule; parser is automatic.

master_vs_project_parameters.coverage_difference: No power action or persistence test is implied.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Preserve bytes/handle and decode each BCD field normatively.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Invalid-field encoding must not be normalized.

review_improvement: KEEP: V3 already confines scope and allows safe Actual collection.
